# Now I'll build the updated content by replacing TODO with the correct release month (MM/YYYY format)
from datetime import datetime

# Map song_id to release month string
release_months = {}
for sid, details in song_details.items():
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(details['release_date'])
    release_months[sid] = dt.strftime("%m/%Y")

# Map song title to song_id for easy lookup
title_to_id = {details['title']: sid for sid, details in song_details.items()}

# Build updated content
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
new_lines = []
for line in lines:
    if 'TODO' in line:
        # Extract the song title (between "- " and " BY")
        # Format: "- Title BY Artist RELEASED_AT TODO"
        title_part = line[2:].split(' BY ')[0]
        sid = title_to_id.get(title_part)
        if sid:
            line = line.replace('TODO', release_months[sid])
    new_lines.append(line)

updated_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(updated_content)
